copy.what: Copies the statement to your clipboard.
copy.why: Paste it into your own tools or the console below and change it — the lab data is yours to modify.

load.what: Opens the statement in the console at the bottom of the page.
load.why: Edit it before running: change a value, add a predicate, compare plans.
load.look: The console slides up; Ctrl/⌘+Enter runs it.

run.what: Runs the statement in your workspace and shows the result under the card.
run.why: Every run goes through a shared queue so one attendee cannot starve the others; a run has a 10 s budget by default.
run.look: Elapsed time and rows under the result; 'served from cache' means this exact card already ran (by you or a classmate).

reset.what: Rebuilds this pattern's tables in your workspace to the starting data.
reset.why: Use it after you've changed data and want the card results — and Measure it — to match the lab again.
